hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock pools that charges a configurable swap fee (0–5%, fixed at launch), split among creator, platform treasury, and a bid-wall bucket. The hook manages a single-sided liquidity "bid wall" below spot price and locks liquidity additions to the factory and itself until the pool graduates (price reaches a configured graduation tick).
